name: Multiset Sequence Masking
description: Replaces the explicit mathematical formula (P / s_u != P / s_v) with an equivalent multiset operation: comparing the sorted sequences of all elements excluding the target. If models fail to logically deduce that these sequences differ if and only if the excluded elements differ, they will implement the check literally. Because the literal check requires the entire array to be populated, it prevents early pruning in backtracking and forces a Time Limit Exceeded.
